description: Frozen 3327-video KuaiRec catalog with public captions/categories. content_types accepts video; put topics or interests in query. search uses BM25 query scores; hot uses aggregate positive-watch counts from the public big table. Scores are source signals, not individual relevance probabilities. duration_ms is a public big-table content measurement. Per-user unknown entries are ineligible. Retrieve up to 100 distinct candidates and recommend exactly 10. limit is the number requested from this retrieval, from 1 to 100; it is separate from the final recommendation count.
